items.distractor_fact: A wannan safiyar, tashar sa ido kan yanayi ta garin Bauchi kuma ta rubuta zafin iska a matsayin digiri {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: That same morning, the weather station in the town of Bauchi also recorded an air temperature of {D}°C. The °C symbol follows the number directly like a suffix and never changes for any integer.
items.entity_note: A different weather station, in a different town (Bauchi), from the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan rana, kasuwar garin Kano ta sayar da hatsi akan farashin $ {D}.
items.gloss_en: That same day, the grain market in the town of Kano sold grain at a price of ${D}. The $ symbol precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: A different, named market (Kano) than the unnamed market in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan rana, Kogin Hadejia ya kai matakin ruwa na mita {D}.
items.gloss_en: That same day, the Hadejia River reached a water level of {D} metres. 'mita' follows the number as an invariant unit noun.
items.entity_note: A different river (Hadejia) from the river in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A lokaci guda, wani jirgin drone daban ya kai tsayin mita {D} bisa matakin ƙasa.
items.gloss_en: At the same moment, a different drone reached an altitude of {D} metres above ground level. 'mita' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different drone (a separate instrument) from the drone in the story, not a second reading of the same drone.

items.distractor_fact: A ranar nan, wani kunshin kaya daban ya kai nauyin kilogiram {D} a tashar isarwa.
items.gloss_en: On that day, a different parcel weighed {D} kilograms at the delivery point. 'kilogiram' is an invariant unit noun after any number.
items.entity_note: A different parcel from the one being tracked in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan shekara, yawan mutanen ƙauyen makwabta ya kai mutum {D}.
items.gloss_en: This year, the population of the neighbouring village reached {D} people. 'mutum' stays invariant as the human-count measure word after any number.
items.entity_note: A different, neighbouring village, not the village whose population is being compared.

items.distractor_fact: A lokaci guda, wata mota daban ta yi gudu na kilomita/awa {D} a wata hanya dabam.
items.gloss_en: At the same time, a different car was travelling at {D} km/h on a different road. 'kilomita/awa' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different car on a different road, not the car whose speed is measured by the radar in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan rana, wani ɗalibi daban yana da $ {D} a hannunsa kafin tafiyarsa.
items.gloss_en: That day, a different student had ${D} on hand before his trip. $ precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: A different student from the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan wata, wani mai asusun banki daban ya ajiye € {D} a asusunsa.
items.gloss_en: This month, a different bank account holder deposited €{D} into their account. € precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: A different account holder from the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan wata, wani ɗan kasuwa daban ya samu kuɗin shiga na $ {D}.
items.gloss_en: This month, a different trader earned income of ${D}. $ precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: A different trader from the one in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan kakar wasa, wata ƙungiya dabam ta zura ƙwallo {D} a raga abokan hamayyarta.
items.gloss_en: This season, a different team scored {D} goals against its opponents. 'ƙwallo' stays invariant as the goal-count measure word after any number.
items.entity_note: A different team from the one whose goal difference the story computes.

items.distractor_fact: Wata masana'anta dabam kuma ta samar da tan {D} na kayayyaki a wannan wata, ko da yake ba a ambáci wani burin samarwa da aka sa mata gaba ba.
items.gloss_en: A different factory also produced {D} tonnes of goods this month, although no production target set for it was mentioned. 'tan' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different factory whose own, unstated target does not apply to the target named in the story (shared-reference domain, rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wani shago dabam ya sayar da kaya kan darajar $ {D} a wannan wata, ba tare da an ambáci wani burin sayarwa da aka sa masa gaba ba.
items.gloss_en: A different shop sold goods worth ${D} this month, without any sales target set for it being mentioned. $ precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: A different shop whose own, unstated sales target does not apply to the target named in the story (shared-reference domain, rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wani gari dabam ya samu ruwan sama na millimita {D} a wannan wata, ba tare da an ambáci wani hasashen yanayi da aka yi masa ba.
items.gloss_en: A different town received {D} millimetres of rainfall this month, without any weather forecast made for it being mentioned. 'millimita' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different town whose own, unstated forecast does not apply to the forecast named in the story (shared-reference domain, rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wani ɗan wasan golf daban ya kammala wani fili na golf dabam da bugu {D}, ba tare da an ambáci daidaiton filin (par) nasa ba.
items.gloss_en: A different golfer finished a different golf course with {D} strokes, without that course's own par being mentioned. 'bugu' stays invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different golfer on a different course whose own, unstated par does not apply to the par named in the story (shared-reference domain, rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wani jirgin ʔan kasuwa daban, mai layin dogo dabam, ya isa tashar a minti {D} bisa lissafin agogo, ba tare da an ambáci jadawalinsa ba.
items.gloss_en: A different freight train, on a different rail line, arrived at the station at minute {D} on the clock, without its own timetable being mentioned. 'minti' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different line whose own, unstated timetable does not apply to the schedule named in the story (shared-reference domain, rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: A wata gasa dabam, Ƙungiyar Fuloti ta zura ƙwallo {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a different competition, Team Fuloti scored {D} goals. 'ƙwallo' stays invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different team in a different competition from the two teams compared in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A wata gasar gudu dabam, Dan wasa Kura ya kai nisan mita {D} daga layin farawa.
items.gloss_en: In a different race, Runner Hyena reached {D} metres from the start line. 'mita' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: A different runner in a different race from the two runners compared in the story.

items.distractor_fact: A ranar nan, garin Kaduna yana da zafin iska na digiri {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: That day, the town of Kaduna had an air temperature of {D}°C. The °C symbol follows the number and never inflects.
